messages.author: 92d094dcc5eabde1
messages.subject: Multilevel moderated mediation in Lavaan
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run two 1-1-1 mediation models . One model has a level 1 moderator while the other has a level 2 moderator. While I was able to test just the mediation effect, I am having trouble introducing the moderators. I would appreciate any insights regarding how and where they can be introduced. Below is the syntax I used to test the mediation model:

model1='
level:1
DV~e*Med+f*IV
Med~d*IV
level:2
DV~b*Med+c*IV
Med~a*IV
IV~~IV
ab:=a*b
totalbw:=ab+c
de:=d*e
totalwith:=de+f'

fit1=sem(model1,data=data,cluster="ID")
summary(fit1,fit.measures=TRUE)
lavInspect(fit1, "icc")

Thanks in advance for your assistance!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel moderated mediation in Lavaan
parts: One model has a level 1 moderator while the other has a level 2 moderator.

I have never seen anything about product-indicators for multilevel data, and I have serious doubts about how that approach would work.  lavaan does not implement LMS estimation.

If your Level-2 moderator is categorical, then a multigroup MLSEM is an option.  But level-1 grouping variables are more complicated.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
